# Scratch

No frontmatter, on purpose. The chunker falls back to the filename stem for the
title and an empty description, and the maintenance checkers flag this note every
time they run.

- Look up whether the gutter above the back door needs a leaf guard
- Ask the specialist what the cambelt job costs in 2029 money

## Notes

Two headings with the same text at the same level, which is an authoring accident
rather than a design. It lives here because the resolver has to refuse a duplicate
*full* path rather than silently pick one, and nothing else in the fixture is
malformed enough to ask it.
